results.title: Microsoft vs. Automatic Data Processing: Scale vs. Seasonality in Revenue
results.author: John Ballard
results.description: Microsoft demonstrates superior revenue growth and consistency compared to Automatic Data Processing, with Microsoft growing at mid-teens rates while ADP grows at mid-single-digit rates. Microsoft's $388 billion annual revenue, driven by 43% Azure cloud growth and 30 million Copilot paid seats, positions it as the leader in AI monetization. ADP's AI platform The Zone shows adoption but hasn't meaningfully lifted revenue growth yet, suggesting the gap between the companies may continue to widen.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Microsoft shows strong and consistent revenue growth (18% YoY), significant Azure cloud expansion (43% growth), successful AI monetization with 30 million Copilot paid seats, and is positioned as the leader in enterprise AI infrastructure and services.

ADP demonstrates stable but modest revenue growth (6.7% YoY) with seasonal fluctuations, high client retention (92%), and AI platform adoption through The Zone. However, AI offerings have not yet meaningfully accelerated revenue growth, and the company faces a widening competitive gap with Microsoft.
